rows.en:
I just wish he wouldn't cause trouble
for everyone around him...
Well then, let's head to Nyan-Nyan.
Yeah!
rows.notes: x16 across many scenes and speakers.

rows.en: (Time to shake it off and eat at Nyan-Nyan!)
Y-yiiiiiikes!!!

Big Bro!
If you glare at people with that scary face,
you'll freak everybody out!
G-goodbye!!

Ah!
\p-kun!!
(Ozma-san is so scary!)
Hiya, Ranka-chan.
Oh, \p-chan.

Ranka... get to work already. This is what
happens when you dawdle: some weirdo
like this gets hold of you.

'Weirdo'...?
How can you say that about my friend, Big Bro!
R-Ranka-chan...

Let's just leave Big Bro and go,
\p-chan.
He really cares about you, huh.

(Time to shake it off and grab a bite
at Nyan-Nyan!)

Ah!
\p-chan!!
(What should I have for dinner...?)

Eating out on the way home would be nice,
but food costs add up...

\p-san, if you walk around
muttering to yourself, people will
think you're weird, you know?

N-Nanase!
Calling me weird is harsh...
Hehe, I'm sorry.
So, what are you up to, Nanase?
I'm out buying rainbow carrots.
rows.notes: 'Nanairo ninjin' (seven-colour carrots) not in the glossary; rendered 'rainbow carrots'.

rows.en:
Carrots?
Huh, are they for your part-time job?
Not for work. They're for Ranka-san.

For Ranka?
Does Ranka even like carrots?
She can't stand them...

I want Ranka-san to have fewer foods she
dislikes, so I'm going to make all kinds of
dishes to help her get over them!
O-oh, really~

I kinda feel like it's fine if she can't
eat carrots, though...

That won't do!
Ranka-san has to be perfect!!
Now, you're coming with me too!

(Nanase totally loses it
when it comes to Ranka.)
Nana-chan, is dinner ready yet~?
It's almost ready, so please wait a little.

\p-kun,
I can't wait for Nana-chan's cooking, can you?

(Nanase warned me not to say a word about
the carrots, so I can't tell her anything...
Sorry, Ranka!)
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Wow~ It looks delicious~

Hey, hey, \p-kun,
what are you gonna eat first?
W-well, let's see...
Yellow soup
Yellow steak
Eat everything
I'll try this yellow soup, I guess...
Th-this is good...
Geez, you're not supposed to gulp soup down!
Teehee.
I'll dig in too!
H-how is it, Ranka-san?
Ah, ahahaha...
Y-you okay?
I-I'm tooootally fine?
rows.notes: 'Daijoubu DAYO' with katakana ending: forced, unconvincing cheer.

rows.en:
Th-thanks for the meal...
I'm all full now...
See you both later...
R-Ranka-san... wait!!

Nanase, you'd better apologize
to Ranka properly, okay?
(It's tasty, but... it's totally carrot soup.)
I'll take on the yellow steak!

Geez, wolfing it down like that
is bad manners, you know?
(It's tasty, but it's just a whole roasted carrot.)
Sorry, Nanase!!
rows.notes: Male only; 'eat everything' branch: the player eats it all, apologising for spoiling Nanase's plan.

rows.en: Hey!
Thanks for the meal.
\p-san...?
\p-kun...?
Wh-what is it?
You idiooot!!
Idiot, idiot, idiooot!!
I'll never forgive you for this!
I'm starving!!

(It's fine. If I'm the one who gets hurt,
then nobody else has to...)

N-Nanase!
Calling me weird is so mean...

For Ranka-chan?
Does Ranka-chan even like carrots?

(Nanase turns into a whole different person
when it comes to Ranka-chan...)

\p-chan,
I can't wait for Nana-chan's cooking, can you?

(Nanase warned me not to say a word about
the carrots, so I can't tell her anything...!)

Hey, hey, \p-chan,
what are you gonna eat first?

missing_glossary: nanairo ninjin (Nanase's carrots, c02936): rendered 'rainbow carrots'.
